attack.verdict: Benign: normal Windows and service logons

attack.name: Group Policy Modification
attack.top_rule: Performance Monitor Users Group Changed
attack.verdict: Benign: SQL Server setup added a service account

attack.name: Modify Registry
attack.top_rule: Registry Value Integrity Checksum Changed
attack.verdict: Benign: Windows state keys (bam, W32Time)

attack.name: File Deletion
attack.top_rule: Powershell was used to delete files or directories
attack.verdict: Benign: Wazuh CIS checks cleaning up temp files

attack.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
attack.top_rule: Powershell script may be using Base64 decoding method
attack.verdict: Benign: build tooling base64 command wrapper (kept visible on purpose)

attack.name: Compile After Delivery
attack.top_rule: Powershell script compiling code using CSC.exe, possible malware drop
attack.verdict: Benign: build tooling Add-Type (kept Critical on purpose)

attack.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack.top_rule: Wazuh agent stopped.
attack.verdict: Benign: planned agent restarts

attack.name: Password Guessing
attack.top_rule: PAM: User login failed.
attack.verdict: True positive: controlled password-guessing test

attack.name: Credentials In Files
attack.top_rule: SentinelGrid FIM: secret or credential file changed
attack.verdict: Benign: planned FIM rule test file in .ssh

attack.name: Brute Force
attack.top_rule: syslog: User missed the password more than one time
attack.verdict: True positive: controlled password-guessing test

attack.name: Account Discovery
attack.top_rule: Suspicious Windows cmd shell execution
attack.verdict: Benign: build tooling shells

attack.name: System Information Discovery
attack.top_rule: Powershell script querying system environment variables
attack.verdict: Benign: Wazuh CIS checks and build tooling

attack.name: Process Discovery
attack.top_rule: Powershell executing process discovery
attack.verdict: Benign: build tooling process checks

attack.name: File and Directory Discovery
attack.top_rule: Powershell script recursively collected files from a filesystem search
attack.verdict: Benign: Windows troubleshooter

attack.name: Lateral Tool Transfer
attack.top_rule: Executable dropped in Windows root folder
attack.verdict: Benign: software installs and updates (SQL Server, .NET, AMD, Logitech)

attack.name: Remote Services
attack.top_rule: sshd: authentication success.
attack.verdict: Benign: admin SSH sessions and loader tunnel

attack.name: SMB/Windows Admin Shares
attack.top_rule: A network share was accessed.
attack.verdict: Low risk: loopback admin share by own account, source process not confirmed

attack.name: SSH
attack.top_rule: sshd: authentication failed.
attack.verdict: True positive: controlled password-guessing test

attack.name: Windows Remote Management
attack.top_rule: Powershell script used "Invoke-command" cmdlet to execute code on remote computer
attack.verdict: Benign: Windows troubleshooter library (same second as SDIAG scripts)

attack.name: Automated Collection
attack.top_rule: Powershell script recursively collected files from a filesystem search
attack.verdict: Benign: Windows troubleshooter

attack.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack.top_rule: Executable file dropped in folder commonly used by malware
attack.verdict: Benign: installers, watchdogs (tuned to 100100), AMD crash reporter, build tooling Add-Type

attack.name: Communication Through Removable Media
attack.top_rule: A new external device was recognized by the system
attack.verdict: Benign: the user's USB headset

attack.name: Stored Data Manipulation
attack.top_rule: Registry Value Integrity Checksum Changed
attack.verdict: Benign: Windows state keys (bam, W32Time)

attack.name: Data Destruction
attack.top_rule: Registry Value Entry Deleted.
attack.verdict: Benign: Firefox removal during posture work

attack.name: Service Stop
attack.top_rule: The Windows search service stopped normally.
attack.verdict: Benign: planned restarts

attack.name: System Shutdown/Reboot
attack.top_rule: System shutdown initiated.
attack.verdict: Benign: planned restarts
